Thread-read: 6500467241
Premise: holds (governing ruling 6499781492 on #27506). On `origin/main` `0e33108a`, ADR-0066 D4's 2026-07 scope note and the `requiredPermissions` docblock still say a `type: 'api'` action is fetched by the browser and never passes through the route. `isHeadlessInvokableAction` admits `script`, `flow` and `operation: 'update'` only (ruling 6499781492, measured).
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `docs/adr/0066*`, `docs/adr/0126*` or `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (the file lists of all open PRs were read). #27506's server PR depends on this one landing first.

Tier H (`docs/adr/**`, `packages/spec/src/**`): the dev opens a draft PR with no `assignees`. An independent full Fable review and the seat's contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` come first. Then the seat hands off to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` via `pr_request_reviewers`, with `needs-user-decision` on the PR.
